title: build_a_chat_app
scenario_seed: user asks to build a chat application with no mention of target platform, scale, persistence requirements, or authentication needs

title: make_a_calculator
scenario_seed: user asks to make a calculator without specifying CLI vs GUI, supported operations, input format, or error handling requirements

title: parse_a_log_file
scenario_seed: user asks to write a log file parser with no detail on log format, fields to extract, output format, or what to do with malformed lines

title: sort_a_csv
scenario_seed: user asks to sort a CSV file without specifying sort column, sort order, delimiter, encoding, or what to do with headers or missing values

title: make_it_faster
scenario_seed: user asks to make it faster with no baseline, no target, and no profiling data — could mean latency, throughput, startup time, or memory usage

title: secure_the_api
scenario_seed: user asks to secure the API without specifying threat model, auth method, transport security requirements, or which endpoints need protection

title: handle_errors_gracefully
scenario_seed: user asks to handle errors gracefully without defining what graceful means — retry? log? crash? surface to user? different per error type?

title: fast_and_secure_and_cheap
scenario_seed: user wants maximum performance, military-grade security, and lowest possible cloud bill simultaneously — the three goals directly conflict

title: rewrite_everything_but_no_downtime
scenario_seed: user wants a full rewrite of a legacy system but also requires zero downtime, zero data loss, and no changes to the external API contract during migration

title: minimum_dependencies_and_all_features
scenario_seed: user wants a zero-dependency library that also has every feature from a full-framework ecosystem

title: linux_only_deployment
scenario_seed: user asks for a deploy script assuming Linux-only paths and tools, but the deployment target includes Windows servers — the assumption is never stated

title: single_user_assumption
scenario_seed: user asks for a to-do app design that assumes a single user, but the actual need requires multi-user collaboration, permissions, and conflict resolution

title: small_data_set_assumption
scenario_seed: user designs a data processing pipeline that works great for 1k rows but fails silently at 1M — no mention of scale requirements was ever made

title: search_bar_scope
scenario_seed: user asks for a search bar — is it full-text search across documents, database query, client-side filter, or an API call to an external search service? scope is not defined

title: export_feature_boundary
scenario_seed: user asks for an export feature without specifying format, which data to export, whether it is one-time or recurring, or whether it is user-initiated or automatic

title: notification_system
scenario_seed: user asks for a notification system without specifying push vs email vs in-app, which events trigger notifications, or whether users can configure preferences

title: gdpr_compliance_omitted
scenario_seed: user designs a user-tracking feature with no mention of privacy regulations — the app operates in the EU and GDPR applies, but the user never brings it up

title: offline_first_unstated
scenario_seed: user asks for a mobile app design without mentioning that the primary use case is offline with occasional sync — all assumptions are online-first

title: accessibility_requirement
scenario_seed: user asks for a web UI design with no mention of accessibility — the organization has legal requirements for WCAG compliance that the user has not stated
